entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Noor Alam was a field hockey player from Pakistan. He won gold medal at the 1960 Summer Olympics and a silver medal, the country's first Olympic medal, at the 1956 Summer Olympics. He was also a member of winning Pakistani team of 1958 and 1962 Asian Games.
